tag: Sprint 14 Task E, F117 (F114 cloud read)

qci-qc-entropy-computing-source: Quantum computing page, first entry: the arXiv link 2407.04512 is followed by the author line starting Lac Nguyen, Mohammad-Ali Miri. The page lists it itself.
qci-qc-patent-giant-nonlinearity: Entry 'Devices and methods for giant single-photon nonlinearities' with its abstract and patent link, then the line 'Y Huang, J Chen US Patent 11,754,908 2023'. The page lists it itself.
qcirs-page-scope: Page header shows Resource library home and Research and publications, then 'Remote sensing' and the first publication entry 'Noise-tolerant single photon sensitive three-dimensional imager'.
qcirs-abstracts-truncated: The page text shows entries cut with an ellipsis before the link, for example 'Our results highlight a ... https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-020-14591-8'. About 14 such cuts. A fact about the page, not about the papers.
tfln-doc-type-policy-paper-no-sources: TFLN page shows 'Thin Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN) May 15, 2024 Policy Paper' as heading and again in the page footer, on the Quantum Computing Inc site.
uqrng-scope-and-purpose: Introduction, last sentence, states the paper's contents exactly as the value says.
uqrng-uniform-rn-definition: Introduction: 'A uniform random number must satisfy two requirements...' with the independence clause in the same sentence.
uqrng-nist-test-config: Data preparation: NIST STS version 2.1.2, 15 tests, each executed 10 times, '10-bit streams' (as printed), assess value 387840. Quotes and passage agree. Note: the Test suites section omits the NIST version number.
uqrng-nist-pass-criterion: Data preparation: each NIST test counts as passed if 0.01 < p < 0.99. The paper's own protocol.
uqrng-dieharder-test-config: Data preparation: Dieharder has 19 tests, KS test on the p-value distribution, each test run 100 times. The paper's own protocol.
uqrng-dieharder-thresholds: Data preparation: default threshold 0.000001 < p <= 0.005 defines WEAK and p <= 0.000001 is FAILED. Labels the paper uses in its results.
uqrng-data-845m-samples: Data preparation: 845 million 32-bit samples via the uQRNG API version 0.0.1 in Python, same set for both suites.
uqrng-dieharder-rewinds: Data preparation: cites Hurley-Smith for the 228 GB minimum, then says Dieharder was run with rewinds for lack of data. A limit of its own runs.
uqrng-tests-not-infallible: Discussion: the tests are not infallible and a set can be built to pass them deliberately. A caveat the paper states about its own validation.
uqrng-other-suites-and-future-work: Discussion, end: 'DieHarder and NIST are two of many possible randomness tests. Testing using other suites may be desirable', then future research on modeling, simulation, cryptography. Stated limit and plan.
uqrng-api-request-limits-and-formats: QCI's QRNG API section: registration and token, one million numbers per request, numbers or binary strings, binary used for NIST and Dieharder, consecutive samples concatenated to 32 bits. Describes how the test data were requested. The request limit is also a product description, but it is stated as part of the protocol.
uqrng-dieharder-rgb-lagged-sum-and-sts-s: Dieharder test table: RGB Lagged Sum 'Test for lagged correlations...' and STS Serial 'accumulates the frequencies of overlapping n-tuples of bits drawn from a source of random integers'. The value's 'n-tuples of bits' is in the full text, past the quote. Descriptions are taken from Dieharder documentation (the paper attributes them to Brown 2023).

theory_low.qci-qc-zeno-gates-theory: Abstract of a cited 2008 Phys Rev A paper listed on the page. The authors' theoretical claim; no proof or conditions on this page.
theory_low.qci-qc-zeno-gates-limit: Abstract sentence of a listed paper, cut off at 'feedback' by the page. A theoretical claim from a different paper, not a limit the page's own work states.
theory_low.qci-qc-fredkin-microdisk-thresholds: Abstract of a listed IEEE paper. A design estimate for practical parameters; the derivation is not on the page.
theory_low.qci-qc-zeno-blockade-phase-gate: Abstract of a listed paper (PRL 110, 223901). A theoretical result; the proof and conditions are not on the page.
theory_low.qcirs-snow-gamma-moments: Abstract of a listed Frontiers in Remote Sensing 2022 paper. Simulation finding (Gamma form) and derived relations; derivations and conditions are not on the page. Measured/claimed result, not proved here.
theory_low.qcirs-snow-half-path-proof: Abstract of a listed Frontiers 2023 paper, which says it proves the half-path result for little snow absorption. The proof is not on the page, only the claim, and the abstract is cut by an ellipsis.
